title: 第11章 被污染的村落第12章 诡异猎人队
content_zh:
银须虎俯冲而下，巨大的虎爪仿佛蒲扇，狠狠的朝着童青山笼罩了过去。
童青山有心试试自己的力量如何，他直接把长枪当棍子用，抡向银须虎的虎爪。
轰隆，虎爪与童青山的长枪的枪柄撞击在一处。
童青山巨大的力量爆发出来，半空中俯冲而下的老虎，竟然失去了平衡，直接被童青山抽的向一侧飞去。
反观童青山，站在原地，腰板挺直，不动如山。
“这……”深水潭活着的几个年轻猎人，都看傻了眼，他们怎么都没想到，童青山竟然能把银须虎给抽飞！
“童青山这么强！”谭英忍不住惊呼。
深水潭村，其他几个侥幸活下来的猎人，也忍不住用力揉眼，不敢相信自己看到的这一幕。
“这怎么可能！银须虎可是这一片大山的王！”
“嘶……枣叶村的童青山，竟然能猎虎！”
“枣叶村，要出大人物了！”
就在那几个年轻猎人心惊肉跳的功夫，童青羽来到了他们身边。
此刻，童青羽安慰道：“表弟别担心，青山哥可是我们枣叶村实力最强的人，肯定能杀虎。”
张楚则喊道：“青山，速战速决，我们还要赶时间。”
“好！”童青山答应了一声，大步朝着银须虎追了过去。
那银须虎也被激起了凶性，主动向着童青山扑击。
同时，银须虎的银须突然发光，一道道银色的神纹，突然激发出来。
那些银色神纹可怕无比，碰触到树木，树木拦腰炸碎，银色神纹仿佛恐怖的绞索，绞向了童青山。
深水潭的猎人队见状，顿时吓得屏住了呼吸，脸色惨白。
但童青山却一往无前，长枪直指老虎，直接无视了那些银色神纹。

就在银色神纹将要斩在童青山身上的时候，他丹田发光，一缕金色神纹直接激发。
所有神纹撞在一起后，同时湮灭，紧接着，童青山的长枪突然加速，直刺银须虎的脑袋。
虽然银须虎竭力躲闪，但童青山的长枪却仿佛有了灵性，始终指着银须虎的眉心。
咔！
长枪直接洞穿了银须虎的脑袋。
银须虎庞大的身体，静止在了原地，眼神中带着不甘。
它怎么都没想到，自己竟会这么轻易的死亡。
而童青山一击得手之后，枪柄微微一颤，直接搅碎了银须虎的脑子，彻底断绝了银须虎的生机。
轰隆，银须虎庞大的身体跌倒在地上，这一片山的王，死在了童青山的枪下！
“我的天，童青山，你竟然，你竟然……”谭英被震撼的说不出话来。
深水潭村，其他几个年轻猎人，也一脸的震撼，他们怎么都没想到，童青山竟然在眨眼间杀了银须虎，这彻底颠覆了他们的认知。
“太厉害了！”有人羡慕无比。
content_en:
The silver-bearded tiger swooped down, its huge claws like cattail fans, and fiercely enveloped Tong Qingshan.
Tong Qingshan wanted to test his strength. He directly used the spear as a stick and swung the silver-bearded tiger's claws.
With a bang, the tiger's claws collided with the handle of Tong Qingshan's spear.
Tong Qingshan's huge power burst out, and the tiger swooping down in mid-air lost its balance and flew to one side directly by Tong Qingshan.
On the other hand, Tong Qingshan stood on the same spot, with his back straight and motionless as a mountain.
"This..." The few young hunters alive in Deep Water Pond were dumbfounded. They never expected that Tong Qingshan could actually drive away the silver-bearded tiger!
"Tong Qingshan is so strong!" Tan Ying couldn't help exclaiming.
In Deep Water Pool Village, several other hunters who were lucky enough to survive couldn't help but rub their eyes hard, unable to believe what they saw.
"How is this possible! The silver-bearded tiger is the king of this mountain!"
"Hiss... Tong Qingshan from Zaoye Village can actually hunt tigers!"
"A big shot is coming to Zaoye Village!"
Just when the young hunters were frightened, Tong Qingyu came to them.
At this moment, Tong Qingyu comforted him: "Don't worry, cousin, Brother Qingshan is the most powerful person in our Zaoye Village, and he can definitely kill the tiger."
Zhang Chuze shouted: "Qingshan, fight quickly, we have to hurry up."
"Okay!" Tong Qingshan agreed and strode towards the silver-bearded tiger.
The silver-bearded tiger was also aroused and aggressively attacked Tong Qingshan.
At the same time, the Silver Beard Tiger's silver whiskers suddenly glowed, and silver divine lines were suddenly activated.
Those silver divine patterns were extremely terrifying. When they touched the trees, the trees exploded to pieces. The silver divine patterns were like a terrifying noose, twisting towards Tong Qingshan.
When the hunters in the deep pool saw this, they were so frightened that they held their breath and turned pale.
But Tong Qingshan moved forward without hesitation, pointing his spear directly at the tiger, ignoring those silver divine patterns.
Just when the silver divine pattern was about to strike Tong Qingshan's body, his dantian glowed, and a ray of golden divine pattern was directly activated.
After all the divine patterns collided together, they were annihilated at the same time. Immediately afterwards, Tong Qingshan's spear suddenly accelerated and pierced the silver-bearded tiger's head.
Although the silver-bearded tiger tried his best to dodge, Tong Qingshan's spear seemed to have spirituality and was always pointed at the center of the silver-bearded tiger's eyebrows.
Click!
The spear pierced directly through the Ginsuhu Tiger's head.
The huge body of the silver-bearded tiger stood still in place, with unwillingness in his eyes.
It never thought that it would die so easily.
After Tong Qingshan succeeded in the attack, the handle of the gun trembled slightly, directly shattering the silver-bearded tiger's brain and completely cutting off the silver-bearded tiger's life.
With a bang, Silver Beard Tiger's huge body fell to the ground. The king of this mountain died under Tong Qingshan's gun!
"Oh my God, Tong Qingshan, you actually, you actually..." Tan Ying was so shocked that she couldn't speak.
In Deep Water Pool Village, several other young hunters also looked shocked. They never expected that Tong Qingshan would kill the Silver-bearded Tiger in the blink of an eye, which completely subverted their cognition.
"That's awesome!" Some people were extremely envious.
